src_comment: The medicinal chemistry literature provides a valuable source of bioactivity data for drug like compounds. Bioactivity data is routinely extracted from our seven core MedChem journals (Bioorg Med Chem Lett, J Med Chem, Bioorg Med Chem, J Nat Prod, Eur J Med Chem, ACS Med Chem Lett, MedChemComm) but also includes selected publications from additional journals.
